name: single-reviewer
description: Use when you can describe the outcome you want but not yet the files you'll touch, and the shape is obvious enough that a plan gate would be ceremony — the default for ordinary product work. Implement (commit as post) -> one review agent -> PR, with automatic revision requests for weak testing. Not for changes small enough that the test suite alone is review (no-review), or for work whose approach needs deciding before anyone builds it (plan-build-review).

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task, then commits as the stage's tail work

post.name: commit
post.prompt: Commit the relevant work for this task before review. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT. Previous implementation result: $PREV_MAIN_RESULT

stages.name: review
stages.description: Review agent checks quality and test coverage before PR creation
stages.prompt: Review branch $BRANCH for task quality and test coverage against base $BASE_REF. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT. Previous implementation result: $PREV_MAIN_RESULT

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR after review passes
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the reviewed work on branch $BRANCH.

post.name: approve
post.prompt: Approve the PR for branch $BRANCH after PR creation and signal the merge master. Previous result: $PREV_RESULT
